// why: The root tsconfig excludes 'supabase', so `npx tsc` has never checked a
single edge function. A wrong variable name in one of them therefore
reached production and surfaced as 'Internal server error: gid is not
defined' while every local check reported PASS.
This config type-checks the edge functions on their own. It cannot resolve
Deno's URL imports, so module errors (TS2307/TS2792) are expected and
filtered by `npm run check:edge`. What it DOES catch is the class of bug
that shipped: an identifier used but never declared.
